assessment_summary: In step 0011, the author incorrectly states that choosing $c_1$ such that $0 \le M \le c_1$ allows them to define the relation $0 \le c_1 g(n) \le f(n)$. Given that $f(n) > M \cdot g(n)$ from step 0010, choosing $c_1 \ge M$ means $c_1 g(n) \ge M g(n)$, which does not guarantee that $c_1 g(n) \le f(n)$. To guarantee this inequality, the author would need to pick $c_1$ such that $0 < c_1 \le M$. Additionally, the proof is incomplete as the author asks for help in proving the second part.
